A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,

Be sure there 
 is no any abnormal noise or vibration and prevented it if found.

Be sure there 
 is no any air or flue gases leakage from manholes and prevented it if found.

Check the 
 operation of the oil lubricating pump and repair it if there is any abnormal 
 condition (noise vibration -leakage Pressure drop ).

Check the oil 
 level of oil lubricating tank and add oil if the level less than 2/3 of oil 
 side glass.

Check the oil 
 level of upper guide bearing and be sure there is no any leakage and add oil 
 if the level less than 2/3 of oil side glass.

Check the oil 
 level of drive unit and be sure there in no any oil leakage and add oil if the 
 level less than 2/3 of oil side glass.

Check and 
 record / measure the temperature of the upper and lower bearing ( its about 40 
 50 C ).

Clean the 
 intake oil filter inside the oil tank.

Read and record 
 the pressure of the oil-lubricating pump (350:380 kpa).

Check the oil 
 level of drive unit of blowing equipment and add oil if the level less than 
 2/3 of oil side glass.

Be 
 sure there is no any leakage in the oil and cooling water pipes and correct 
 it if found.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
Vertical rotary 
 regenerative air heater use for 
 heating air to combustion chamber by heat transfer from outlet gasses .
 This document lists the equipment inspection I1 of vertical rotary 
 regenerative air heater, which must be, performed every 2 month base as 
 indicated by M2 in the title block. 
 .
The first draft initiated by 
 eng.: Adel Mahmoud Al-Maadawi, reviewed by maintenance director eng. 
 Saad Mostafa, revised by eng. Samir Abdel-Gelil at EDEPCo.,accepted by 
 maintenance general director: Ali Mostafa Al-lithy and approved by 
 eng.Mostafa Alam Head Sector of Talkha steam power station 2 x 210 MW.
Updated by eng. Fawzy Ahmed 
 Basuoni, accepted by maintenance general director: Mohmed Ali Abou 
 Alnga and approved by eng. Farok Awod Ali Head Sector of Talkha steam 
 power station 2 x 210 MW. revised by eng. Magdy Hgazey at MDEP Co., 
 accepted by general director: Samir Abdel-Gelil and approved by eng.: 
 Mohmed Nageb Head Sector of Inspection& Quality control sector .
This document is updated for 5 years review
Safety Precautions
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Wear safety 
 helmet, shoes.
A work permit 
 must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
 safety category,
Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Cleaning fluid, Feeler gauge.
Work to be Carried Out
Be sure there 
 is no any abnormal noise or vibration and prevented it if found.
Be sure there 
 is no any air or flue gases leakage from manholes and prevented it if found.
Check the 
 operation of the oil lubricating pump and repair it if there is any abnormal 
 condition (noise vibration -leakage Pressure drop ).
Check the oil 
 level of oil lubricating tank and add oil if the level less than 2/3 of oil 
 side glass.
Check the oil 
 level of upper guide bearing and be sure there is no any leakage and add oil 
 if the level less than 2/3 of oil side glass.
Check the oil 
 level of drive unit and be sure there in no any oil leakage and add oil if the 
 level less than 2/3 of oil side glass.
Check and 
 record / measure the temperature of the upper and lower bearing ( its about 40 
 50 C ).
Clean the 
 intake oil filter inside the oil tank.
Read and record 
 the pressure of the oil-lubricating pump (350:380 kpa).
Check the oil 
 level of drive unit of blowing equipment and add oil if the level less than 
 2/3 of oil side glass.
Be 
 sure there is no any leakage in the oil and cooling water pipes and correct 
 it if found.
